01

A report before the first cited verse

A report transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī.

753
Report from Sufyān No. 753: 1: 2

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
753: 1:2. Sufyan:
"and he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people": He said, midday (verse 15).
العربية
753: 1: 2 سفيان وَدَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ عَلَى حِينِ غَفْلَةٍ من أهلها قال نصف النهار (الأية 15) .

02

“Which of the two terms did Moses fulfill?”

An explanation transmitted from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib (Q 28:28).

754
Explanation from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib No. 754: 2: 1

ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib

English
Transmission wording
754: 2:1. Sufyan, from Ata ibn al-Saib, who said:
Said ibn Jubayr met a monk, and Said asked, "Which of the two terms did Moses fulfill?" He did not know. [Said said:] I met Ibn Abbas and asked him, and he said, "He fulfilled the more complete of the two" (verse 28).
العربية
754: 2: 1 سفيان عن عطاء بن السايب قَالَ لَقِيَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ رَاهِبًا فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَيَّما الأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَى مُوسَى فَلَمْ يَدْرِ فَلَقِيتُ بن عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ قَضَى أَوْفَاهُمَا (الآية 28) .

03

“You were not at the side of the mountain when We called”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 28:46).

755
Explanation from Sufyān No. 755: 3: 3

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
755: 3:3. Sufyan:
"You were not at the side of the mountain when We called": He said, "O Muhammad, I gave you before you called upon Me, and I answered you before you asked Me" (verse 46).
العربية
755: 3: 3 سفيان كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الطُّورِ إِذْ نَادَيْنَا قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتُكُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَدْعُونِي وَأَجَبْتُكُمْ مِنْ قبل أن تسئلوني (الآية 46) .
Edition record 371472 · p. 233Link to report ↗
04

“everything will perish except His face”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 28:88).

756
Explanation from Sufyān No. 756: 4: 2

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
756: 4:2. Sufyan:
"everything will perish except His face": He said, whatever is done for His face (verse 88).
العربية
756: 4: 2 سفيان شئ هالك إلا وجهه قَالَ مَا أُرِيدَ بِهِ وَجْهُهُ (الآية 88) .
